verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents WebAuthn as a first-class login method. It covers adding WebAuthn to the browser flow, WebAuthn as a second factor, and "LoginLess WebAuthn", plus a dedicated Passkeys section with conditional UI/autofill, modal UI and mediation. That fully covers the passkey half of the story. The evidence never mentions magic links or email OTP as built-in sign-in methods, so that half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented magic-link login, documented email OTP sign-in, independent or hands-on corroboration of the passkey flows.
